next_step: Kick off 2-week on-prem POC: confirm NDA, get sample monorepo, deliver signed plugin build and test matrix
notes:
Summary: OrbitCode builds a JetBrains plugin (IntelliJ/PyCharm) that provides enterprise-grade AI code completion and an IDE copilot. Primary ask: extremely low latency streaming completions, local indexing of large monorepos, option to pin specific model versions per workspace, and an offline mode for high-security customers.

Discovery notes: - 2026-02-18 initial inbound via developer forum; invited by Maya for intro. - 2026-03-02 deep-dive with CTO (ff_20260302_orbitcode_intro): CTO quote: "We need completions under 50ms for local buffer streaming; anything >150ms feels laggy for users." - 2026-03-09 architecture review (ff_20260309_arch_deepdive): SE requested kernel selection docs and quantization guidance. - Provided Redwood pricing deck and security FAQ (see drive links).

Technical requirements: - Client plugin must support local indexing pipeline (index builder runs as background process on dev machine or dedicated index server). - Ability to run completions via private deployment (on-prem or VPC) and fall back to hosted API for dev-mode. - Model/version pinning: workspace-level manifest to lock model + quantization profile. - Low-memory footprint on macOS M1/M2; engineering asked for perf numbers and memory/cpu per-token estimates. - Streaming: partial tokens must arrive to editor as soon as available (token-level streaming), with graceful degrade to non-streaming if network choked. - Telemetry must be opt-in; default telemetry = off for enterprise customers.

Security/compliance: - Must support SSO/SAML and SCIM provisioning for team seats. - Audit logs for prompts and responses (retention controls configurable per account). - KMS integration for any customer-managed keys required for Private deployment. - Data residency: EU-hosted control plane and option to keep embeddings on-prem only.

POC plan and success criteria: - 2-week on-prem POC using a representative monorepo (~40M LOC) and 15 engineers on IntelliJ. - Success: median completion latency <80ms (95th <200ms) for local-index-enhanced completions; memory per IDE plugin <1GB; no telemetry leakage; seamless SSO login; model pinning works across workspace clones. - Deliverables: signed plugin build for internal testing, performance report, and recommended deployment topology.

Quotes / customer voice snippets: - "Offline-first is a hard requirement for our regulated clients." - Lead engineer: "If indexing takes hours we lose dev buy-in — incremental indexing / background low-priority scans needed."

Next steps (short): - Send NDA and POC statement of work (SOW). - Devs to provide sample monorepo access (read-only) and a VM spec for indexing node. - Redwood SE to provide benchmark config and kernel/quantization guide.

Other notes: procurement loop is 6-8 weeks; procurement already flagged pricing as a blocker. Internal champion: Head of Developer Platform (Eva Morales).
